lines.text: What do you think, Old-Timer? Do I look like a real witch?
Trick or treat! Gimme some candy, or get ready for a prank!
Want some of this candy? It's really good!
Hey, Old-Timer, let's go look at some Halloween toys ♡
From now on, you're gonna spend every Halloween with me, okay? ♡
I'll only give you the tastiest candy ♡
Old-Timer! If you don't get out here quickly, I'm gonna cast a terrible curse on you!
Hmm...! I gotta think of some pranks I can pull with Old-Timer this Halloween ♡
Come check out the toy store! This little witch will be waiting for you ♡
Old-Timer, have you seen Mica? We said we'd make Halloween decorations together, but she ran off!
I hid some pumpkin candy around here. Try to find it!
Belorta the witch, reporting for candy! Let's have some fun, Old-Timer!
Now I'll have an even better Halloween ♡
I feel like I'm becoming a real witch!
I just thought of a fun prank!
A Halloween present? Thanks ♡
Can I display this at the toy store? I want to look at it every day ♡
I always love your gifts!
I like you even more than candy ♡
If anyone's bothering you, just let me know. I'll get them back with a prank!
Spending Halloween with you is the best ♡
Can I bring my candy bucket?
I'm here, Old-Timer!
I can't believe I don't get a broom!
Eek! Spooky monsters!
Let's get this Halloween party started!
I'm gonna put a curse on you!
Let me show you what a witch can do!
Getting my next prank ready.
Witches need time to prepare too!
Maybe I'll sneak just one piece of candy...
Get ready for a surprise gift ♡
Little witch triiick!
Here we go! Curse 'em with all you got!
Get pranked ♡
Too easy ♡
See that, Old-Timer?!
Eek!
Ah!
Ouch!
I was hoping to have a better Halloween...
Mwahaha! A witch always wins ♡
